### L1 review (L1-d) — #35094 (Closes #35018, PR 2: Studio landing) · 2026-11-18T02:59Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: f96134972df801e433051f3a4172a4492d5b2a6f

**Surface.** All 4 files are inside the PR 2 slice of claim 6964950830: `BuilderLanding.tsx` (the landing in `ui/packages/app-shell`), two of its existing tests, and a root changeset. No locale file changes. `engine.studio.pkg.writable` stays because `PackageSwitcher` and `PageShell` still read it. NOT governed (`check-governed-merges --branch`): 0 of 4 paths, 148 changed lines. f9613497 is a merge of main.

**Item 4a, own-app cards.** The id line and the 可写 badge are removed. The row carries `title={p.id}`, the installed card's existing pattern. Own cards have no more menu, only Duplicate, so the card's "more menu or hover title" choice falls to the title. Live (after log): `showsId: false`, `badge可写: false`, the first title in the card is `com.qa.mtg`, and 可写 appears 0 times on the page (it was 2 before).

**Item 4b, 最近访问.** `recentRepeatsCards` is `recent.length === cardIds.size && every(recent ∈ cardIds)`. This is a set equality, and it holds because the recent store dedupes by id (`RecentItemsProvider` `addRecentItem` drops the prior entry) and `recentPackages` is filtered to listed packages. `cardIds` covers both writable and installed cards. A `.custom` pair folded under its base has no card, so a visit to one keeps the row. The before and after logs on the same three-card page show the row gone after when it repeats exactly. With a fourth own app (`com.qa.crm`) the row stays, because the cards then hold an app the recent list does not repeat.

**On the dev's open reading, which the requester asked me to weigh: I accept A, the same set.** 「内容与上方卡片完全重复」 says the content repeats the cards completely, which is a two-way match. B (hide whenever every recent entry has a card) would drop the row in the common case of a few apps. That throws away what the row adds even then, the order of recency, and it would be a feature change the card rules out (「不改这些页面的布局与功能」).

**Pins and ablations.** There are two new describes:
- own card: no id text and no Writable on the face, with the id reachable by title;
- recent row: hidden for one visit to the only app, and for every card visited in any order with installed apps included; two CONTROLs keep it (a recent app with no card, and a card the row does not repeat).

The six existing fixtures each gained one unvisited app, so they keep testing a drawn row rather than going vacuous. Four mutations went red and were restored. The `accessibleNames-12510` edit is a comment only.

**Clause-②: no** and **Metadata-protocol: none** are correct: this is display only.

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix: none.

Notes:
- The out-of-scope observation that recent-row entries still show a monospace package id under the name is for the seat. That row is not one of the card's four items, but it is the same class of issue.
- This PR is `Closes #35018` while PR 1 (#35082) is still in the merge queue. If this one lands first, the card closes with PR 1 unmerged, so either keep the order or reopen the card for PR 1.
- CI at review time: 13 success, 13 skipped, 23 in progress. Landing waits on all checks being green.

Landing: ordinary queue landing (not Tier H) via the area, after #35082.

Delta from my ACCEPT on f96134972d (6967686193). There are two commits: ad4aebc0 (code and pin) and 4f122a5c (changeset wording). Together they change 3 files, +21/-4, all already in the PR's file list and in the PR 2 slice of claim 6964950830 (the 最近访问 strip in `BuilderLanding.tsx`, its tests, the changeset).

**Scope.** This folds the observation I passed to the seat in my first verdict: the recent-row entries showed a mono package id. Triage proposed carrying it on this PR (6967733592) as the same rule on the same component, and the seat and area agreed. It is the card's own rule (no raw identifiers on the landing) applied to one more row, and it changes no layout or behaviour, so I accept it in scope.

**Code.** Each recent entry loses the `font-mono` `item.name` line and gains `title={item.name}` on its `Link`, the same pattern as the own and installed cards. The visible label (`recentLabel(item)`) is untouched, so the link's accessible name is still the app's label (`accessibleNames-12510`'s `/HotCRM/` link is unaffected).

**Pin.** The new case asserts that the entry shows `Acme CRM`, that its `textContent` has no `com.acme.crm`, and that `getByTitle('com.acme.crm')` is the link itself. Both ablations went red and were restored, per the area. **Live:** `after-4-recent-no-id.png` (zh-CN 1280, three own apps) shows the 最近访问 entries 工单跟踪 / 会议纪要 / ObjectStack Showcase with no id line, the own cards with no id or 可写, and no recent-row duplication.

`git merge-tree` against the current `origin/main`, with #35082 now merged, reports no conflict. Still NOT governed.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.
